the_ruling_verbatim: it means we need a new terminal state to our workflows, but i don't see why not. this is part of the design of the system as a whole. And since each ticket can have it's own workflow, once we have a ruled on it, the workflow should be edited to allow that terminal.
now_the_spec_says: SUPERSEDED is a terminal state. A ticket whose work was carried under a different ticket edits its own workflow to add the SUPERSEDED terminal and crosses to it, naming what carried the work.
